codec.name: postcard
rules: enum variants are the varint (LEB128, u32) of the variant index — tables below are the pinning contract
signed ints (i16/i32/i64) are zigzag-varints (none appear in V1 payloads)
option<T> is a 0x00/0x01 tag byte followed by T when present
string and seq<T> are a varint length prefix followed by the items
structs encode fields in declaration order

conversation: client connects, sends Hello { proto_version, agent } as the FIRST frame
driver replies Welcome { proto_version, session_id, tree_seq, frame_seq, adapter } or Error { UnsupportedVersion }
any other first frame is rejected with Error { NotHandshaked }
each subsequent request is answered by exactly one response frame; queued events may be flushed between responses
Bye is answered by Bye and closes the connection
description: Binary-first CDP-style protocol: sessions -> targets (windows) -> domains; request/response + server-push events. This document is the contract for non-Rust clients (§16).

variants.name: Click
variants.payload: { x: f64, y: f64, button: PointerButtonV1, count: u32 varint (Playwright clickCount: 1 = click, 2 = double-click) } → GestureDone; synthesized as move→down→up ×count (§9)

variants.name: Drag
variants.payload: { from_x: f64, from_y: f64, to_x: f64, to_y: f64, button: PointerButtonV1 } → GestureDone; down→ratchet-interpolated moves (adapter pacing, ~5 px/tick)→up (§9)

variants.name: Wheel
variants.payload: { dx: f64, dy: f64 } → GestureDone; logical-px deltas

variants.name: Key
variants.payload: { key: string, modifiers: seq<string> } → GestureDone; synthesized as down→up (§8.4 key-name vocabulary)

variants.name: Type
variants.payload: { text: string } → GestureDone; one TextInput commit — adapters translate to IME or per-key events (§4.2)

variants.name: Start
variants.payload: { opts: VideoOptsV1 { fps: u32 varint (0 = driver default), dir: option<string> (client-owned artifact dir) } }

variants.name: Use
variants.payload: { handle: string (WindowInfoV1.handle) } → WindowUsed | Error { UnknownWindow }; aims the CALLING connection at the target — subsequent Resolves only see that window's subtree (per-connection state, §16 v0.4)

events.name: FramePresented
events.payload: { seq: u64 varint, hash: u64 varint }

requests.name: Action
requests.payload: { node: NodeKeyV1, generation: u32 varint, action: SemActionV1, force: bool, timeout_ms: u64 varint }

requests.name: Input
requests.payload: { events: seq<InputEventV1> } — injected into the sending connection's active window target (M7) → InputQueued

responses.name: Welcome
responses.payload: { proto_version: u32 varint, session_id: string, tree_seq: u64 varint, frame_seq: u64 varint, adapter: AdapterInfoV1 }

responses.name: TreeSnapshot
responses.payload: { tree_seq: u64 varint, node_count: u64 varint }

responses.name: Resolved
responses.payload: { node: NodeKeyV1, generation: u32 varint, rect: option<[f64; 4]> }

responses.name: ClockState
responses.payload: { virtual_time_ms: option<u64 varint>, paused: bool, steps: u64 varint }

responses.name: VideoFile
responses.payload: { path: string, frames: u64 varint, dropped: u64 varint, duration_ms: u64 varint }

title: Guiwright Protocol (GWP) wire schema

window_info.fields: { handle: string (stable target id: the AccessKit subtree TreeId for multi-window adapters, 'main' for single-window), title: string, focused: bool }
window_info.name: WindowInfoV1
